author: iKronix_Gaming
body:
Dear Avicus Support,

I am really sorry for making a false thread. I was annoyed at the time due to other reasons and I know this was wrong. I know I won't do it ever again and I'm sorry for the trouble that I've caused. I am so keen to be back on Avicus and I am annoyed that I can't go on for about a month because of a forum post, I don't blame the staff, I blame myself. I just really hope that you will accept me back on the basis that I won't do it again. I have never had an infraction for a forum post so I think I deserved another chance.

Regards,

DaCrowMan

title: My temp-ban

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
If it was wrong, why would you do it anyway? You're not sorry for the trouble, you're sorry because you got banned. You say you blame yourself, but you got lit against the staff, going as far as being rude to seniors saying they don't have a brain or even to where you got hostile in your appeal with that "last word". You blamed us for your failiures to follow the rules. You already know your infraction was legitimate, no point appealing to say sorry. Plus, your appeal was already denied. Also, didn't one of your appeals say before if you made another you'd be punished...? Actually, you say you won't do something again, but you get another punishment a next day. 

Also, you seemed to have turned the story and lied even more. You lied in your last appeal too. You say you know this was wrong, but you were certain on it being a joke and acted like you didn't even know why or what happened.

You also are lucky you don't have a multiple infractions ban, better to take this instead. And... you don't "deserve" anything. Playing here is a privilege, not a right.
